steps.name: Preview server serves actual built HTML
Desktop home, fonts, semantic content, and layout
Real unpointed Hebrew query returns complete-text results
Niqqud and plain Hebrew queries agree
Quoted phrase search finds the opening verse across editions
Category filter and search result navigation
Search terms highlight in pointed source text
Reader typography, theme persistence, and bookmark
Saved page is discoverable from the home page
Book continuation restores the last reading section
Empty search and no-match states remain usable
A fresh category search loads only relevant shard metadata
A failed worker chunk is visible and a new query retries successfully
Complete source and chapter navigation without JavaScript
Mobile home, readable text, and accessible contents
External records and verified local-reader links work without JavaScript
External title search loads on demand and filters its own provider index
External author search preserves source identity and does not invent local mappings
External catalogue and metadata remain readable on mobile
No JavaScript errors or failed static asset requests

localFullHtml.method: One sequential local render, not the GitHub matrix. Same full source release; no baseline timing on identical hardware. Other focused validation processes ran concurrently.

verificationProfile.label: full-verify-html
verificationProfile.rssMeasurement: Sampled sum of RSS for the child and descendants on Linux; shared pages can be counted more than once and short peaks can be missed.

notes: Artifact sizes are GitHub ZIP bytes; the contained tar.zst archives are slightly smaller. This estimate is conservative for result-cache eligibility.
Compressed-source weights use corresponding source artifact ZIP sizes, slightly larger than tar.zst sizes used in prepare.
Sampled RSS sums child and descendant processes; shared pages can be counted more than once and peaks shorter than250 ms may be missed.
Predicted cache eligibility is not an observed warm cache hit.

includes: archive usable when cache budget is zero
restored shard cache is pruned to reduced budget
parallel integration workspaces use unique temporary directories

firstGitHubFullBuild.queryValidation: Not executed on the full corpus in this first run. Native global and scoped smoke gates are scheduled for the follow-up run.
notes: Build only; no website deployment was performed.
Local full-index artifact retrieval was blocked by the connector512 MiB download limit; this is a tool limitation, not a product failure.
Archive byte counts are GitHub transport ZIP sizes; tar.zst payloads are slightly smaller.
RSS is sampled process-tree RSS and may double-count shared memory.
firstGitHubFullBuild.durationMethod: GitHub run run_started_at to final updated_at, including dispatch/queue overhead; baseline is the original single build job duration.
